title: SS-BERT: MITIGATING IDENTITY TERMS BIAS IN TOXIC COMMENT CLASSIFICATION BY UTILISING THE NOTION OF “SUBJECTIVITY” AND “IDENTITY TERMS”

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the false positive rate in toxic comment classification models when non-toxic comments contain specific demographic identity terms (encompassing race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, and political affiliation), and evaluating mitigation by correlating these predictions with sentence subjectivity scores.
